The '''Lakra system''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Lakra]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Fool's Bargain" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lakra system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it within grid square I-6.<ref name="TEA" />
